project.name: Dipoorlet
project.description: Offline quantization tool for ONNX models with activation calibration (Mse, Minmax, Hist), weight transformation (BiasCorrection, WeightEqualization, Adaround, Brecq, QDrop), and deployment to TensorRT, SNPE, STPU, Atlas, TI, RV, MagicMind, IMX

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package initialization file containing version metadata.

nodes.name: __main__.py
nodes.summary: Main CLI entry point for Dipoorlet quantization tool. Parses arguments, initializes distributed training, loads ONNX model, runs tensor calibration, weight transformation, profiling, and deploys to target platform.

nodes.name: utils.py
nodes.summary: Core utility module providing ONNXGraph class for ONNX model manipulation, logging setup, calibration value management (save/load/reduce), profiling result handling, and data restoration utilities.

nodes.name: ONNXGraph
nodes.summary: Main ONNX graph wrapper class providing tensor shape/type management, initializer handling, node insertion/deletion, topological ordering, and model serialization. Supports multiple deployment backends.

nodes.name: setup_logger
nodes.summary: Configures logging with both file and console handlers with colored output support.

nodes.name: cos_similarity
nodes.summary: Computes cosine similarity between two tensors. Returns 0 if dot product is zero.

nodes.name: max_abs_gap
nodes.summary: Computes maximum absolute difference between two tensors.

nodes.name: save_clip_val
nodes.summary: Saves activation and weight clip values (ranges) to JSON files for calibration data persistence.

nodes.name: load_clip_val
nodes.summary: Loads activation and weight clip values from JSON files, converting back to numpy arrays.

nodes.name: reduce_clip_val
nodes.summary: Collects clip values from all distributed ranks and reduces them (mean for non-minmax, max for minmax).

nodes.name: save_profiling_res
nodes.summary: Saves per-layer and per-model cosine similarity profiling results to JSON files per rank.

nodes.name: reduce_profiling_res
nodes.summary: Collects profiling results from all ranks and computes mean cosine similarity and min worst-case similarity.

nodes.name: restore_data
nodes.summary: Restores calibration data from binary files into batched files for layerwise profiling.

nodes.name: quantize.py
nodes.summary: Core quantization module that transforms ONNX graphs by inserting QuantizeLinear/DequantizeLinear nodes. Handles weight/input quantization with per-channel or per-layer scaling, symmetric/asymmetric modes.

nodes.name: quant_graph
nodes.summary: Main quantization entry point. Clones graph, identifies quantizable nodes from platform settings, inserts fake quant nodes for weights and activations.

nodes.name: insert_fake_quant_node
nodes.summary: Inserts QuantizeLinear/DequantizeLinear node pairs for weights and inputs. Handles ConvTranspose transpose, ReLU merging, TRT-specific Add handling.

nodes.name: insert_fake_quant_node_output
nodes.summary: Inserts quant nodes at network output boundaries based on platform settings.

nodes.name: delete_fake_quant_node
nodes.summary: Removes fake quant nodes from graph, restoring original tensor connections. Used in layerwise profiling to measure individual layer impact.

nodes.name: get_qnode_by_param
nodes.summary: Creates quantization parameters (scale, zero_point) based on calibration ranges. Handles per-channel vs per-layer, symmetric vs asymmetric, and log_scale quantization modes.

nodes.name: make_quant_dequant
nodes.summary: Factory function that creates a complete QuantizeLinear + DequantizeLinear subgraph with scale and zero_point tensors. Supports per-channel axis parameter.

nodes.name: profiling.py
nodes.summary: Profiling module for measuring quantization error. Computes cosine similarity between float and quantized model outputs at layer and model levels. Supports multipass and transformer model profiling.

nodes.name: quantize_profiling_multipass
nodes.summary: Profiles quantization error for standard CNN models by running forward passes with calibration data. Computes layer-wise and model-wise cosine similarity.

nodes.name: quantize_profiling_transformer
nodes.summary: Profiles quantization error for transformer models using activation caching to optimize memory and computation. Handles batched inference efficiently.

nodes.name: quantize_profiling_layerwise
nodes.summary: Measures per-layer quantization sensitivity by iteratively removing quant nodes and computing error delta. Uses cosine or max_abs gap criterion.

nodes.name: show_model_ranges
nodes.summary: Logs tensor value ranges (min/max) for activations and weights, showing per-channel info if applicable.

nodes.name: weight_need_perchannel
nodes.summary: Analyzes weight distribution to identify layers that would benefit from per-channel vs per-layer quantization. Uses heap to rank layers by channel-range to layer-range ratio.

nodes.name: show_model_profiling_res
nodes.summary: Displays profiling results: layer-wise cosine similarities and top-20 worst layers, plus model output-level average and min cosine similarity.

nodes.name: forward_net.py
nodes.summary: ONNX model forward execution module with ONNXRuntime. Provides activation caching for transformers, minmax/histogram/MSE statistics collection, and tensor retrieval utilities.

nodes.name: ActivationCache
nodes.summary: Caches intermediate tensor activations for transformer models to avoid redundant computation. Splits network into per-node subgraphs for selective forward execution with reference counting.

nodes.name: forward_get_tensor
nodes.summary: Runs a single forward pass on the full network and returns all tensor outputs as a dictionary keyed by tensor name.

nodes.name: forward_get_output
nodes.summary: Runs forward pass using batched data directory and returns network outputs as dictionary.

nodes.name: forward_get_minmax
nodes.summary: Collects min/max statistics from all tensors by running inference with calibration data. Used for minmax activation calibration.

nodes.name: forward_get_hist
nodes.summary: Collects histogram statistics of tensor absolute values for histogram-based calibration.

nodes.name: forward_net_octav
nodes.summary: OCTAV-based calibration method that iteratively finds optimal scale parameter s_n using percentile-based threshold.

nodes.name: input_data_generator
nodes.summary: Generator that yields calibration input data as dict of numpy arrays from binary files, indexed by tensor name.

nodes.name: dist_helper.py
nodes.summary: Distributed training initialization utilities for MPI and SLURM environments. Sets up PyTorch distributed process groups with master address/port from environment variables.

nodes.name: init_from_mpi
nodes.summary: Initializes distributed training from OpenMPI environment variables (OMPI_MCA_orte_hnp_uri). Extracts master IP via regex parsing.

nodes.name: init_from_slurm
nodes.summary: Initializes distributed training from SLURM environment variables (SLURM_JOB_ID, SLURM_PROCID, SLURM_NTASKS, SLURM_NODELIST). Computes port from job_id.

nodes.name: platform_settings.py
nodes.summary: Platform-specific quantization settings for multiple backends (TensorRT, S-TPU, MagicMind, RV, Atlas, SNPE, TI, IMX). Defines which layers to quantize, bit width, per-channel/per-layer mode, symmetry.

nodes.name: dipoorlet/tensor_cali/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel module for tensor_cali package. Exports tensor_calibration from tensor_cali_base and find_clip_val_minmax_weight from basic_algorithm.

nodes.name: tensor_cali_base.py
nodes.summary: Core tensor calibration module. Provides tensor_calibration function that dispatches to algorithm-specific methods for activation calibration and uses minmax for weight quantization.

nodes.name: tensor_calibration
nodes.summary: Main calibration entry point. Uses minmax method for weight quantization and dispatches to algorithm-specific activation calibration based on args.act_quant.

nodes.name: basic_algorithm.py
nodes.summary: Calibration algorithm implementations. Contains tensor_cali_dispatcher with registered algorithms: minmax, hist, and mse. Also provides find_clip_val_minmax_weight for per-channel weight clipping.

nodes.name: tensor_cali_dispatcher
nodes.summary: Decorator-based dispatch function for calibration algorithms. Registers handlers for minmax, hist, and mse calibration methods.

nodes.name: find_clip_val_minmax
nodes.summary: Minmax activation calibration. Computes per-tensor clip values using min/max statistics, with optional transformer optimization.

nodes.name: find_clip_val_hist
nodes.summary: Histogram-based activation calibration (KL divergence). Accumulates histogram and finds clipping threshold based on args.threshold.

nodes.name: find_clip_val_octav
nodes.summary: MSE-based activation calibration using OCTAV iterative optimization. Computes optimal clipping values by minimizing MSE.

nodes.name: find_clip_val_minmax_weight
nodes.summary: Per-channel minmax weight quantization. Extracts weights from Conv/FC layers, handles ConvTranspose transpose, computes per-channel clip values.

nodes.name: dipoorlet_utils/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty utility package init file.

nodes.name: calibrator.py
nodes.summary: Calibration data generation and TensorRT calibration utilities. Provides CalibDataLoader for ImageNet data, Calibrator class for TRT INT8 calibration, and helper functions for YOLOv8/ResNet18 calibration data generation.

nodes.name: CalibDataLoader
nodes.summary: Data loader for TensorRT calibration. Loads ImageNet calibration images with preprocessing (Resize 248, CenterCrop 224, Normalize).

nodes.name: Calibrator
nodes.summary: TensorRT INT8 entropy calibrator implementing trt.IInt8EntropyCalibrator2. Handles batch data loading and calibration cache read/write.

nodes.name: dataset.py
nodes.summary: Image dataset loading utilities for calibration and evaluation. Supports TinyImageNet and standard ImageFolder structures. Provides ImageNetEvaluator for model validation, TinyImageNetDataset and StandardImageFolder datasets, and get_dataloaders() unified entry point.

nodes.name: ImageNetEvaluator
nodes.summary: Validates trained models on ImageNet validation set. Computes Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy metrics.

nodes.name: TinyImageNetDataset
nodes.summary: PyTorch Dataset for Tiny ImageNet structure (200 classes with train/val/test splits).

nodes.name: StandardImageFolder
nodes.summary: PyTorch Dataset for standard ImageFolder structure. Similar to torchvision.datasets.ImageFolder.

nodes.name: setup.py
nodes.summary: Package setup configuration. Reads requirements from requirements.txt, generates version from CI environment variables, uses setuptools.find_packages.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package init that exports weight_calibration function from weight_trans_base module.

nodes.name: weight_trans_base.py
nodes.summary: Orchestrates weight calibration pipeline combining bias correction, weight equalization, BN updates, ADAROUND, BRECQ, and sparse quantization. Runs distributed with rank 0 doing updates while all ranks barrier.

nodes.name: ada_quant_layer.py
nodes.summary: Implements AdaRound quantization layers including adaround_reg regularizer, TempDecay scheduler, AdaQLayer class with forward methods for Conv/Gemm/ConvTranspose, and quantization functions quant_acti/quant_weight/quant_weight_nnie/quant_acti_nnie.

nodes.name: adaround.py
nodes.summary: Implements ADAROUND weight quantization algorithm. Per-layer optimization using ActivationCache for activation capture, AdaQLayer for quantized layer emulation, and learning_round_mask for training round masks. Reference: https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.10518

nodes.name: bias_correction.py
nodes.summary: Implements bias correction for quantized Conv and Gemm layers. Calculates bias difference between fp and quantized activations and corrects or adds bias terms to maintain accuracy.

nodes.name: brecq.py
nodes.summary: Implements BRECQ weight quantization algorithm with Q-drop support. Processes layer blocks together using ActivationCache and AdaQLayer. Trains AdaBlock (nn.Sequential of AdaQLayers) with learning_round_mask supporting dropout-based Q-drop mode.

nodes.name: sparse_quant.py
nodes.summary: Implements sparse quantization combining weight pruning with quantization. Uses SparseQLayer for layer emulation, prunes weights via prune_weight, and quantizes without round mask. Supports unstruction and nv24 pruning patterns.

nodes.name: sparse_quant_layer.py
nodes.summary: Implements SparseQLayer with STE straight-through estimator, quant_weight_wo_roundmask, prune_weight with unstruction/nv24 patterns, and create_unstruction_mask/create_nv24_mask utilities.

nodes.name: update_bn.py
nodes.summary: Updates BatchNormalization running mean/var using quantized activations. update_bn_multipass processes each BN node incrementally; update_bn_onepass processes all at once. Currently configured to use multipass approach.

nodes.name: utils.py
nodes.summary: Utility functions for weight transformation: follow_relu/following_relu detect ReLU after conv layers; update_weight modifies initializer; get_quant_tensor builds per-channel or per-tensor quantization tensors; get_block_from_first extracts layer blocks up to depth 3.

nodes.name: weight_equalization.py
nodes.summary: Implements cross-layer weight equalization for Conv->Conv or Conv->Relu->Conv patterns. Finds successor nodes, computes scaling factors s for weight groups, iteratively converges weights. Helper node_has_equalized checks if node has exactly one successor.

nodes.name: weight_calibration
nodes.summary: Main entry point orchestrating weight calibration pipeline. Applies bias correction, weight equalization, BN updates, and ADAROUND/BRECQ/sparse quantization in sequence based on args flags. Returns updated graph alongside original for reference.

nodes.name: adaround_reg
nodes.summary: AdaRound regularizer module with TempDecay schedule. Provides rectified_sigmoid for smooth round mask and forward method computing F-norm regularization. Uses zeta=1.1, gamma=-0.1, alpha=0.01 as default parameters.

nodes.name: TempDecay
nodes.summary: Temperature decay scheduler for AdaRound beta parameter. Cosine annealing from start_b=20 to end_b=2 starting at 20% of total iterations. Returns 0.0 before decay begins.

nodes.name: AdaQLayer
nodes.summary: Quantization-aware layer mimicking Conv/Gemm/ConvTranspose with trainable round_mask parameter. Builds torch conv/linear/deconv from ONNX node info. Forward applies quant_weight/quant_weight_nnie then convolution, optionally followed by ReLU and activation quantization via quant_acti/quant_acti_nnie.

nodes.name: nnie_rest_init
nodes.summary: Initializes NNIE-restricted weights with special non-uniform quantization. Computes zero point based on max value, handles positive/negative/zero regions separately with log2 scaling.

nodes.name: quant_acti
nodes.summary: Quantizes activations with stochastic rounding based on prob. Divides by scale, rounds, clamps to [q_min, q_max], multiplies back by scale.

nodes.name: quant_weight
nodes.summary: Quantizes weights with soft (sigmoid-based) or hard rounding. Uses floor division plus round mask contribution, then clamps per-channel or per-tensor.

nodes.name: quant_weight_nnie
nodes.summary: NNIE-specific weight quantization with 16-level log2 scaling and zero point computation. Handles positive/negative/zero regions distinctly.

nodes.name: quant_acti_nnie
nodes.summary: NNIE-specific activation quantization with 16-level log2 scaling. Computes zero point from max value, handles positive/negative/zero regions.

nodes.name: L2_norm
nodes.summary: L2 norm loss between prediction and target across batch dimension, returning mean.

nodes.name: adaround
nodes.summary: Applies ADAROUND algorithm to learn optimal rounding for each learnable layer. Skips weight-equalized nodes, uses ActivationCache for activations, trains AdaQLayer with learning_round_mask, deploys quantized weights back to model.

nodes.name: learning_round_mask
nodes.summary: Trains round_mask parameter using Adam optimizer with L2 loss plus AdaRound regularization. 1 epoch training with batched inputs, logs loss and rounding statistics.

nodes.name: update_conv_node_bias
nodes.summary: Calculates bias correction as mean difference between fp and quantized activations over spatial axes. Adds correction to existing bias or creates new bias tensor if none exists.

nodes.name: bias_correction
nodes.summary: Iterates through Conv/Gemm nodes, computes quantized activations via quant_graph, compares with fp activations, updates bias for each layer. Saves corrected model.

nodes.name: brecq
nodes.summary: Applies BRECQ algorithm processing layer blocks together. Gets block via get_block_from_first, builds AdaBlock (nn.Sequential of AdaQLayers), trains with Q-drop support. Handles activation quantization with following_relu detection.

nodes.name: learning_round_mask
nodes.summary: Trains all round_mask parameters in AdaBlock with Adam optimizer. Supports Q-drop via ratio-based stochastic input selection. Logs epoch progress and rounding statistics.

nodes.name: sparse_quant
nodes.summary: Applies sparse quantization combining pruning with quantization. Uses SparseQLayer for layer emulation, prunes weights then quantizes without round mask. Supports unstruction and nv24 pruning patterns with configurable rate.

nodes.name: learning_sparse_quant
nodes.summary: Trains SparseQLayer weights using SGD with cosine annealing scheduler and momentum. L2 loss between quantized and fp outputs. Logs epoch and learning rate.

nodes.name: STE
nodes.summary: Straight-Through Estimator autograd function. Forward rounds input, backward passes gradient unchanged. Used for quantization without gradient disruption.

nodes.name: quant_weight_wo_roundmask
nodes.summary: Quantizes weights using STE for rounding, divides by scale, clamps to [q_min, q_max], multiplies back. No trainable round mask unlike ADAROUND.

nodes.name: create_unstruction_mask
nodes.summary: Creates unstructured sparsity mask by zeroing out the smallest magnitude weights up to target sparsity rate.

nodes.name: create_nv24_mask
nodes.summary: Creates N:V (2:4) structured sparsity mask where 2 out of every 4 elements are zero. Reshapes weight, sorts by magnitude, zeros smallest N per row.

nodes.name: prune_weight
nodes.summary: Applies sparsity mask to weights based on pattern (unstruction or nv24).

nodes.name: L2_norm
nodes.summary: L2 norm loss between prediction and target across batch dimension.

nodes.name: SparseQLayer
nodes.summary: Quantization layer with sparse weight pruning. Builds torch conv/linear/deconv, prunes weights via prune_weight in forward, quantizes with quant_weight_wo_roundmask, applies optional ReLU.

nodes.name: update_bn_node
nodes.summary: Updates BatchNormalization running mean and variance using quantized activations with exponential moving average (momentum=0.9). Computes mean and std over spatial dimensions.

nodes.name: update_bn_multipass
nodes.summary: Updates BN nodes one at a time with incremental quantization cache restoration. Each node gets its activations quantized using current ranges, then BN stats are updated. Re-calibrates after all updates.

nodes.name: update_bn_onepass
nodes.summary: Updates all BN nodes in a single pass with a fixed quantization graph. Faster than multipass but less accurate.

nodes.name: follow_relu
nodes.summary: Checks if a node's output is consumed by exactly one Relu node. Used to detect if convolution output passes through ReLU.

nodes.name: following_relu
nodes.summary: Returns the Relu node following a given node. Asserts exactly one consumer of type Relu exists.

nodes.name: update_weight
nodes.summary: Updates an initializer tensor in the graph with new weight values.

nodes.name: get_quant_tensor
nodes.summary: Builds scale/q_min/q_max tensors for quantization from qnode parameters. Handles per_channel mode by reshaping scale and bounds to broadcast along channel dimension.

nodes.name: get_block_from_first
nodes.summary: Extracts a sequence of learnable layers starting from a given node, following tensor consumers through Relu and Conv/Gemm/ConvTranspose layers. Max block length is 3.

nodes.name: find_successor
nodes.summary: Finds Conv successors following Conv->Relu->Conv or Conv->Conv patterns. Returns list of successor Conv nodes or empty list if pattern doesn't match.

nodes.name: node_has_equalized
nodes.summary: Checks if a node has exactly one Conv successor (meaning it has been equalized). Used to skip already-equalized nodes in ADAROUND/BRECQ.

nodes.name: weight_equalization
nodes.summary: Cross-layer weight equalization for Conv nodes with exactly one Conv successor. Computes per-channel scaling factors s, iteratively updates weights until convergence (threshold 1e-4). Handles grouped convolutions.

nodes.name: converged
nodes.summary: Checks if weight update converged by computing sum of L2 norms between current and previous weights. Returns True if total norm < threshold (1e-4).

nodes.name: mock_data.py
nodes.summary: Generates random calibration data as binary files for model quantization.

nodes.summary: Trains MobileNetV2 from pretrained torchvision weights for 200-class classification. Uses SGD optimizer with step LR scheduler, trains for configurable epochs with best model saved based on validation accuracy.

nodes.name: train_model
nodes.summary: Enhanced training function with early stopping, configurable optimizer (Adam/SGD), learning rate scheduler (plateau/step/cosine), and checkpoint resume capability.

nodes.name: get_config
nodes.summary: Command-line argument parser for training configuration including resume path, epochs, learning rate, optimizer type, scheduler type, batch size, and weight decay.

nodes.name: LabelSmoothCrossEntropyLoss
nodes.summary: Custom loss function implementing label smoothing for better generalization during training. Applies smoothing factor to reduce overconfidence on labels.

nodes.name: EMA

nodes.name: mixup_data

layers.name: CLI / Entry Point
layers.description: Command-line interface and main orchestration. Parses args, initializes distributed training, loads ONNX model, drives the quantization pipeline.

layers.name: Graph Utilities (ONNX Manipulation)
layers.description: Core ONNX graph abstraction. Provides ONNXGraph class for node/tensor/initializer manipulation, topological ordering, shape inference, quantization helpers, serialization, and dataset utilities.

layers.name: Distributed Training
layers.description: Multi-GPU / multi-node coordination wrappers for MPI and SLURM environments.

layers.name: Platform Configuration
layers.description: Central registry mapping deploy target (trt, snpe, qnn, rv, magicmind, ti, imx, atlas, stpu) to quantization parameters: bit-widths, symmetric/asymmetric mode, per-channel/per-tensor settings, which layers to quantize, and deploy-specific flags.

layers.name: Tensor Calibration (Activation Quantization)
layers.description: Collects activation ranges from calibration data via ONNXRuntime forward passes. Implements three calibration algorithms: MinMax, Histogram (with KL thresholding), and MSE (OCTAV). Includes weight-only minmax clipping.

layers.name: Forward Network (ONNXRuntime Inference Engine)
layers.description: ONNXRuntime-based inference for calibration data collection. Provides per-subnet caching for transformer models (ActivationCache) and standalone forward functions for classic models.

layers.name: Quantization (Graph Rewriting)
layers.description: Injects Q/DQ (QuantizeLinear/DequantizeLinear) fake-quantization nodes into the ONNX graph, setting up scale/zero-point tensors. Supports per-channel and per-tensor quantization, symmetric and asymmetric modes, and channel-last transpose for ConvTranspose.

layers.name: Weight Transformation
layers.description: Post-calibration weight transformations that improve quantized model accuracy. Includes BiasCorrection, WeightEqualization, Adaround, BrecQ/QDrop, sparse quantization, and BN update. Orchestrated by weight_calibration in weight_trans_base.py.

sub_modules.adaround: Activation-based range optimization for weight rounding
sub_modules.brecq: Bit-level reconstruction; QDrop adds stochastic drop

layers.name: Profiling (Quantization Error Analysis)
layers.description: Layer-wise and model-wise quantization error profiling using cosine similarity and max-abs-gap metrics. Supports multipass and transformer architectures. Outputs per-layer and aggregated profiling JSON.

layers.name: Deployment (Platform-Specific Export)
layers.description: Writes quantized model and range files in target accelerator's format. Base dispatcher routes to platform-specific generators for TensorRT, SNPE, QNN, RV, MagicMind, TI, IMX, Atlas, STPU. Each deploy_*.py registers with the dispatcher and writes config blobs.

layers.name: Shared Utilities
layers.description: Dataset loading (binary files) and calibration-data batch generation used across calibration and profiling.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Dipoorlet is an offline quantization tool for ONNX models. It supports activation calibration (Mse, Minmax, Hist), weight transformation (BiasCorrection, WeightEqualization), and SOTA finetune algorithms (Adaround, Brecq, QDrop). Generates quantitative parameters for multiple platforms (TensorRT, SNPE, STPU, ATLAS, etc.). Start here to understand the project's purpose and capabilities.

tour.title: CLI Entry Point
tour.description: The main CLI entry point invoked via `python -m dipoorlet`. Parses command-line arguments, initializes distributed training (MPI/SLURM), loads the ONNX model via ONNXGraph, drives the full quantization pipeline (calibration → weight transformation → profiling → deploy), and routes output to the target platform.

tour.title: ONNX Graph Utilities
tour.description: The ONNXGraph class is the core abstraction for model manipulation. It provides tensor shape/type management, initializer handling, node insertion/deletion, topological ordering, shape inference, quantization helper methods, and model serialization. Also provides calibration value management (save/load/reduce) and profiling result utilities used across distributed ranks.

tour.title: Distributed Training Coordination
tour.description: Multi-GPU and multi-node coordination wrappers for MPI and SLURM environments. Handles distributed initialization, inter-process communication for calibration data reduction, and profiling result aggregation across ranks.

tour.title: Platform Configuration
tour.description: Central registry mapping deploy target (trt, snpe, qnn, rv, magicmind, ti, imx, atlas, stpu) to quantization parameters: bit-widths, symmetric/asymmetric mode, per-channel/per-tensor settings, which layers to quantize, and deploy-specific flags. Shapes the quantization strategy per target accelerator.

tour.title: Tensor Calibration (Activation Quantization)
tour.description: Collects activation ranges from calibration data via ONNXRuntime forward passes. Implements three calibration algorithms: MinMax (forward_get_minmax), Histogram with KL thresholding (forward_get_hist), and MSE/OCTAV (forward_net_octav). Includes weight-only minmax clipping. Supports both classic CNN and transformer architectures with dedicated forward variants.

tour.title: Quantization (Graph Rewriting)
tour.description: Injects Q/DQ (QuantizeLinear/DequantizeLinear) fake-quantization nodes into the ONNX graph, setting up scale/zero-point tensors. Handles per-channel and per-layer quantization, symmetric and asymmetric modes, ConvTranspose channel-last transpose, ReLU merging, and TRT-specific Add handling. The quant_graph function is the main entry point; insert_fake_quant_node handles node insertion; get_qnode_by_param computes scale/zero-point.

tour.title: Weight Transformation
tour.description: Post-calibration weight transformations that improve quantized model accuracy. Includes BiasCorrection (corrects bias after quantization), WeightEqualization (equalizes per-channel ranges), Adaround (activation-based range optimization for weight rounding), Brecq/QDrop (bit-level reconstruction with stochastic drop), sparse quantization (structured sparsity via mask generation), and BN update. Orchestrated by weight_calibration in weight_trans_base.py.

tour.title: Profiling (Quantization Error Analysis)
tour.description: Layer-wise and model-wise quantization error profiling using cosine similarity and max-abs-gap metrics. Supports multipass CNN profiling (quantize_profiling_multipass), transformer profiling with activation caching (quantize_profiling_transformer), and layerwise sensitivity analysis (quantize_profiling_layerwise). Outputs per-layer and aggregated profiling JSON for accuracy bottleneck identification.

tour.title: Deployment (Platform-Specific Export)
tour.description: Writes quantized model and range files in each target accelerator's format. Base dispatcher (deploy_base.py) routes to platform-specific generators: TensorRT, SNPE, QNN, RV, MagicMind, TI, IMX, Atlas, STPU. Each deploy_*.py registers with the dispatcher and writes config blobs and model files tailored to the target hardware.

tour.title: Shared Utilities
tour.description: Dataset loading (binary calibration files) and calibration batch generation used across calibration, weight transformation, and profiling. The calibrator.py module provides activation range collectors; dataset.py handles binary data loading and batch formation.
